description: Multi-Fidelity Simulator MFSim provides a pluggable NASA framework combining low-fidelity national air-traffic-flow simulation with higher-fidelity regional components. The provider is NASA Ames Research Center. Geographical and temporal coverage: The NASA metadata describe the United States airspace; time resolution depends on fidelity and the selected plugins. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is not stated in inspected metadata. A price for reuse is not established; consult the provider. Caveats: NASA metadata establish the simulator. The linked old project landing page now redirects to a general NASA division page; code delivery and licence remain unverified. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. It is conceptually related to model-bluesky, which supplies a comparison or modelling context; compatibility is not asserted.
